sources.title: Small-field hash-based SNARGs are less sound than conjectured

required_scope.code: An extension code of a linear code over a smaller base field; Reed-Solomon evaluation domains in that base field are relevant.

sources.operational_boundary: The paper does not give an efficient practical attack on a compiled SNARG. Its information-theoretic limitation nevertheless prevents using an unsupported list-size premise as a soundness theorem.
